messages:
incident-bot: URGENT: PROD alerts: elevated 5xx on /v1/generate (us-east-1) after canary deploy at 18:04 UTC. Error spike tied to KMS Decrypt AccessDenied on key alias 'alias/redwood-prod-key-2'. @oncall please acknowledge.

maria.chen: ack. I'm oncall. seeing 500s across a subset of canary tasks in us-east.

akash: which rollout was this? I see canary rollout for 'embedding-opt2' at 18:02 (10% traffic).

jules: logs show repeated failure: 
```
ERROR KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException
botocore.exceptions.ClientError: An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the Decrypt operation: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789:assumed-role/infra-canary-role/i-0abcd is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789:key/ffff-eeee
```
New task role doesn't have Decrypt on the key alias; looks like the role change in the canary task def dropped the KMS grant.

priya: I pushed an IAM role update as part of iam-rollout-qa at 17:55. I assumed KMS access was provided via group policy. I'll check.

maria.chen: immediate steps: 1) flip kill-switch (feature flag) to stop canary traffic, 2) rollback canary image if traffic still hitting canary, 3) patch key policy or role to include kms:Decrypt, 4) re-run canary after verification.

akash: ready to flip. CLI command?

jules: `redwoodctl feature set --env prod embedding-opt2 false --reason "kill-switch: KMS errors"`

akash: flipping now.

deploy-bot: Feature update: embedding-opt2=false by akash at 18:08 UTC. Traffic should stop routing to canary.

maria.chen: errors reduced but a few tasks still failing (they already pulled new role). Let's rollback the canary runtime.

jules: executing rollback: `deploy-bot rollback --service embed-canary --to-tag v2.1.4`

deploy-bot: Rolling back embed-canary to v2.1.4. Estimated 90s.

taylan: pinging CS: initial impact message sent to support with ticket INC-17999. Affected: small subset of EU and US dedicated orgs using embedding endpoints.

support-lead: received. Marking customer-impact: moderate. Gathering org IDs and timestamps.

priya: I inspected the role diff. The new role arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/infra-canary lacks a condition that allowed kms:Decrypt on alias/* after rotation. Also earlier this week we rotated alias to point at new key id. The role never got explicit key policy mapping. I'll add a key policy statement granting the role Decrypt and DescribeKey.

akash: paste the key policy snippet?

priya: quick snippet to add to key policy (applies to key resource): 
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowCanaryRoleDecrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/infra-canary" },
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
I'll update key policy and re-apply role.

maria.chen: rollback status?

deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 18:11 UTC. Canary tasks now on v2.1.4.

jules: smoke checks against rolled-back cohort show no KMS errors. Trying a couple of generate requests — OK.

maria.chen: prio now: patch key policy, re-deploy corrected role to a small canary cohort, run 5m of traffic and automated smoke tests, then ramp. Also log follow-ups: ensure deploy PR template includes KMS alias check and add a preflight CI test that validates role->key permissions.

taylan: drafted customer update: apologize, explain mitigation (feature-flag kill, rollback, policy fix), estimate for next safe attempt, and offer to reach out once final. Sending to CS now.

akash: also recommend adding an automated canary abort if KMS Decrypt errors > 0.5% for 2 minutes.

priya: key policy updated at 18:15 UTC, role reverted and redeployed to canary subset at 18:17.

deploy-bot: Deployed infra-canary role update; replacing tasks gracefully.

jules: first canary cohort got the role fix at 18:20 and smoke tests (20 calls) all passed, no Decrypt errors.

maria.chen: ok re-open canary at 18:22 at 1% traffic with tight observability (KMS, 5xx, latency).

incident-bot: Alert thresholds adjusted: /v1/generate 5xx < 0.5% over 5m. Noted.

maria.chen: 15m after ramp: metrics stable, no customer-facing errors logged. taylan, please update the support ticket and mark as mitigated pending postmortem.

taylan: updated ticket INC-17999; customers notified and will await final postmortem.

akash: postmortem action items: 1) add KMS-policy validation to deploy CI, 2) add canary abort automation for KMS errors, 3) extend deploy PR checklist to include key alias verifications, 4) run an infra audit over all task roles that access KMS keys.

maria.chen: handing off to jules for final postmortem and follow-ups. I'm offcall.

jules: acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem and track the CI changes.

support-lead: marking customer-impact alert closed. Will reopen if any regression.

maria.chen: thanks everyone. Quick note: good use of kill-switch and rollback — reduced customer impact. Let's get that preflight check in place this week. :thumbsup:
